text:
Nina P.: Quick note from the FinServ prospect: they want an auditable one-time 'break glass' token for a BYO-HSM cutover. asking whether we can sign something they can hand their custodian.
Rafael M.: Security perspective: we can provide a time-limited, single-use signed artifact that authorizes an unwrap via our key-proxy. fully offline unwrap without network requires key escrow and a ceremony.
Tara S.: Procurement question: how do we price key-ceremony / escrow? is that in the standard BYO SOW?
Ben K.: Standard SOW includes onboarding + 2 dev rotations. Any additional ceremonies or recovery drills are PS, billed by day. Add-on for attestation reports and simulation exercises.
Nina P.: They also asked whether the break-glass unwrap would count as normal KMS ops or a special HSM fee.
Rafael M.: Operationally it's a KMS unwrap. For BYO-HSM there's a connector fee plus a small per-unwrap surcharge when routed through the customer-managed path.
Tara S.: They want a short cutover checklist (ports, test commands, rollback steps). Can we provide a 1-pager?
Ben K.: Yes. I'll draft a 1-page runbook: staging tests, required egress to staging.kms.redwood:443 and attestation.redwood:443, an unwrap sanity check, a 15-minute canary phase, and a rollback to redwood-managed key if issues.
Nina P.: Blocker from legal: need explicit TTL and revocation language for the signed artifact.
Rafael M.: Proposed text: single-use, TTL-bound token revocable by Redwood; revocation events logged and retained. Send draft and we'll sign off.
ops-bot: Created ticket REDWOOD-POC-522: FinServ BYO-HSM break-glass runbook, assigned to Ben K. ETA 4 business days.
Tara S.: I'll gather custodian contact and firewall list and share with the team.
Nina P.: Thanks, team. I'll update the customer after Ben shares the 1-pager.
